establishment_regulation_required.quote: Prior to the issuance or renewal of a written authorization or permit pursuant to section 448-29, the board shall...require an on-site inspection of the facility, equipment, and personnel

definition_quote.value: A person practices dentistry, within the meaning of this chapter, who represents oneself as being able to diagnose, treat, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw, or who offers or undertakes by any means or methods to diagnose, treat, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the same, or to take impressions of the teeth or jaws; or who owns, maintains, or operates an office for the practice of dentistry; or who engages in any of the practices included in the curricula of recognized and approved dental schools or colleges.
definition_quote.quote: A person practices dentistry, within the meaning of this chapter, who represents oneself as being able to diagnose, treat, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw, or who offers or undertakes by any means or methods to diagnose, treat, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the same, or to take impressions of the teeth or jaws; or who owns, maintains, or operates an office for the practice of dentistry; or who engages in any of the practices included in the curricula of recognized and approved dental schools or colleges.

methods_authorized.quote: Dentistry includes that part of health care concerned with the diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of diseases of the teeth, oral cavity, and associated structures including the restoration of defective or missing teeth.

drug_authority.value: Licensed dentists may prescribe for conditions of the teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw, and may administer general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate (conscious) sedation with a written permit from the board.
drug_authority.quote: No licensed dentist shall administer or employ another person...to administer general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate (conscious) sedation for dental patients, unless the licensed dentist possesses a written authorization or permit from the board.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Prior to the issuance or renewal of a written authorization or permit pursuant to section 448-29, the board shall...require an on-site inspection of the facility, equipment, and personnel to determine whether the facility and staff requirements pursuant to section 448-29(d) have been met.

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: for pediatric patients, a licensed dentist shall follow the American Academy of Pediatrics and American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry Guidelines for Monitoring and Management of Pediatric Patients During and After Sedation for Diagnostic and Therapeutic Procedures.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A licensed dental hygienist shall practice only under the supervision of a licensed dentist as provided in this chapter; provided that a licensed dental hygienist: (1) May administer under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist only those categories of intra-oral block anesthesia...(2) May practice under the general supervision of a licensed dentist....(3) May practice under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist
